Single-line diagram (SLD) – example ratings, Ik values per IEC 60909 (c_max 1.05 / c_min 0.95)
20 kV utility network, S″k = 500 MVA (example – ask the utility)
HV fuse size from the transformer maker table
Z_T 9.6 mΩ · R_T 1.68 mΩ · X_T 9.452 mΩ
I_r 1440 A · I_sd 4·I_r, t_sd 0.3 s · I_g 0.3·I_n
Ik3 = 24.37 kA (25.3 kA with K_T) · ip = 55.1 kA → I_cw 36 kA / 1 s
I_r 200 A · I_sd 2 kA, t_sd 0.1 s
Legend: ⊗-blade = circuit breaker · bar-blade = disconnector · circles = transformer · two plates = capacitor · arrow box = SPD · ΔU = total from MDB (limit 4 %).
Ik1 = minimum earth-fault current at the machine (hot cables, c_min) – must be ≥ I_a (MCCB 1.2·I_m = 960 A, MCB C 10·I_n).
